name: ATM Diagnostic Request V 03
definition: The ATMDiagnosticRequest message is sent from an ATM to an acquirer to verify the availability of the acquirer. The acquirer will also validate that this ATM is a valid ATM for its particular network.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMDiagnosticRequest.name: ATM Diagnostic Request
ATMDiagnosticRequest.definition: Information related to the request of a diagnostic from an ATM.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC.
